fixture: synthetic 8 MiB high-entropy ZIP member compressed with deflate
boundary_checks: empty and multi-block inputs, 8 MiB member, first/middle/last byte mismatches, duplicate members, CRC errors, forced comparator fallback and SHA-256 path
limitations: Peak RSS covers an entire synthetic benchmark process, including LuaJIT and the expected bytes; it is not the Kindle memory footprint or total chapter-open memory.
Benchmark uses one synthetic ZIP entry; CPU time does not measure full chapter downloads, display or physical Kindle speed.
